question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4 - abrupt**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the sudden and significant geological changes that occur during an earthquake.
 
• The word "abrupt" fits well as it conveys the sense of suddenness and lack of warning, which aligns with the unpredictable nature of earthquakes.
 
• Other options like "innovative," "expansive," and "deliberate" do not fit the context of describing sudden geological movements.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Innovative (नवोन्मेषी): "Innovative" refers to creativity or new ideas, which is not relevant to the description of earthquakes.
 
• Expansive (विस्तृत): "Expansive" refers to something that covers a large area, which does not convey the suddenness of earthquakes.
 
• Deliberate (जानबूझकर): "Deliberate" means intentional, which contradicts the unpredictable nature of earthquakes.
